network_status.network: Dopo 12 anni dal crollo la Provincia consegna i lavori di ricostruzione del Ponte sul Savuto
network_status.summary_it: Le fonti controllate confermano il cedimento del ponte sul Savuto durante la piena tra l'11 e il 12 dicembre 2008, ma non pubblicano livello, portata, stazione o orario di colmo. La piena documentata resta quindi distinta da una misura idrometrica.
network_status.summary_en: The reviewed sources confirm failure of the Savuto bridge during the flood between 11 and 12 December 2008 but publish no stage, discharge, station or peak time. The documented flood therefore remains distinct from a hydrometric measurement.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
